SELECT cohort_id, 
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT comment FROM participants.contact_notes WHERE participant_id = p.id ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) AS example_comment 
FROM participants p 
GROUP BY cohort_id;

       (SELECT contact_notes FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.participant_id = p.participant_id ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) AS example_contact_note 
FROM participants p

args.query:
UPDATE cohort_summary
SET example_contact_note = (SELECT contact_notes 
                            FROM participants 
                            WHERE cohort = cohort_id 
                            AND contact_notes IS NOT NULL 
                            ORDER BY RANDOM()
                            LIMIT 1)
WHERE example_contact_note IS NULL;
